content.text:
The data records diagnoses only, with no timing or direction, so it can't settle causal direction on its own. I didn't run any asymmetry test. The answer rests on the clinical mechanism. A C7 nerve root radiculopathy can produce pain and dysfunction that is felt in the shoulder (referred or radicular pain). A shoulder problem does not cause compression of the cervical nerve root.

ANSWER: A
